gloss: all of them; every one; any of them

definitions.explanation: Refers to every item in a group without exception, emphasizing that the same quality or condition applies to each one.

examples.japanese: どれも⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
どれも⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: They all look the same to me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どれも⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{安心|あんしん}して→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧⟦{買|か}えます→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: All the products are high quality, so you can buy them with confidence.

notes:
Combines the interrogative pronoun ⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧ (which one) with the inclusive particle ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ to mean "all of them" or "every single one." Used when referring to multiple items or options and indicating that the same judgment applies to each.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- どれも〜⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: none of them (with negative verb)
- どれも⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧: they're all the same
- どれも⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: each and every one (emphatic)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- どれも⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧: they're all delicious
- どれも⟦{素晴|すば}らしい→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧: they're all wonderful
- どれも⟦{気|き}に{入|い}らない→気に入る：02047_kiniiru⟧: I don't like any of them

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どちらも→どちらも：08721_dochiramo⟧: both (used for two items)
- ⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: any one of them / whichever (implies choosing one)
- ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧: all, everything — more general; どれも emphasizes individual items within a visible group
